items.title: Explain a paper
items.prompt: Explain the key claim, method and limitation of this paper in five sentences, then say whether the evidence supports the claim.

items.title: Compare options
items.prompt: Compare {A} and {B} on cost, risk and time-to-value in a table, then recommend one and say what would change your mind.

items.title: Fact-check
items.prompt: List every factual claim in the text below, mark each verified, unverified or false, and cite what you used.

items.title: Explain a stack trace
items.prompt: Read this stack trace, name the root cause before the fix, then give the smallest patch and how to prove it.

items.title: Write tests
items.prompt: Write unit tests for this function covering the happy path, one boundary and one failure case. No mocks unless unavoidable.

items.title: Review a diff
items.prompt: Review this diff for correctness, security and readability. Rank findings by severity and skip style nits.

items.title: Refactor safely
items.prompt: Refactor this into smaller functions without changing behaviour. Show the diff and list what could break.

items.title: Tighten this
items.prompt: Cut this text by 40% without losing a fact. Keep every number and name.

items.title: Rewrite for a beginner
items.prompt: Rewrite this for someone with no background, using one analogy and no jargon.

items.title: Turn notes into a doc
items.prompt: Turn these notes into a structured document with a summary at the top and decisions called out.

items.title: Plan a week
items.prompt: Plan the next seven days for this goal. Each day gets one concrete action with a completion test.

items.title: Pre-mortem
items.prompt: Assume this plan failed six months from now. List the five most likely reasons, ranked, with the cheapest early warning for each.

items.title: Estimate
items.prompt: Estimate the effort for this in days, show your assumptions, and give the range rather than a single number.

items.title: Budget
items.prompt: Build a monthly budget from these numbers in rupees. Use the calc tool, show the arithmetic, and flag the one line most likely to overrun.

items.title: Compare loans
items.prompt: Compare these two loan offers on total interest paid, not EMI. Do the arithmetic with the calc tool.

items.title: Flashcards
items.prompt: Turn this material into twelve question-and-answer flashcards, hardest first.

items.title: Teach it back
items.prompt: Explain this concept, then ask me three questions that would prove I understood it.

items.title: Review an APK
items.prompt: Inspect this APK in the sandbox: list its permissions, native libraries and any suspicious entry names, then say what each implies.

items.title: Harden a config
items.prompt: List the risky defaults in this configuration, what an attacker gains from each, and the exact change to make.

items.title: Draft a message
items.prompt: Draft a short, polite message to {person} about {topic}. Give two versions: one firm, one soft.

items.title: Decide
items.prompt: I am deciding between these options. Ask me the three questions that would actually settle it, then recommend.

items.title: Summarise a thread
items.prompt: Summarise this conversation into decisions made, open questions and who owns what.
